readiness_interpretation: Completes the conditional decision's runtime prerequisite. Historical source policy/binding readiness flags describe the prior un-enrolled stage and are not rewritten. Every new run still performs fresh preflight and notice checks before records.
output_contract: Run-scoped start and terminal app receipts; immutable acquired-release evidence and separate legacy offline local-review normalization. Successful app receipt binds independently verified manifests, exact source evidence and counts.
checkpoint_contract: Before-row source-use retention and per-response journal. Completed acquisitions survive later normalization failure; reuse verified retained evidence instead of reacquiring for promotion.
cancellation: Cooperative IPC and AbortSignal. Unpublished owned acquisition/normalization staging is cleaned; published releases and durable app history are preserved.
concurrency: Managed industry source/executable reservations plus exclusive output-root app and acquisition locks.
retention: Internal source evidence and local-review normalization; operator-governed retention. No automatic deletion of completed releases.
